description: Analyze Klever smart contract Rust source code for common issues. Checks for missing imports, missing #[klever_sc::contract] macro, missing endpoint annotations, payable handlers without call_value usage, storage mappers without #[storage_mapper], and missing event definitions. Returns findings with severity (error/warning/info) and links to relevant knowledge base entries.

contractName.description: Human-readable name for the contract (used in output labeling). Defaults to "contract" if omitted.

sourceCode.description: The full Rust source code of the Klever smart contract to analyze. Must be valid Rust code using klever_sc imports.

name: analyze_contract
